主要内容: On January 27, 2012, KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. issued a press release announcing its earnings for the fourth quarter of 2011. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information in this report is not deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section. The press release provides details about the company's financial performance for the quarter. The filing was signed by Gregory J. Dawson, the Chief Financial Officer of KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC.
